records.text: The National Security Agency redirected Candace Owens's FOIA request to the Department of War.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: We had first heard back from the NSA who informed us that the request was redirected to the Department of War.

verification.notes: NSA guidance explains that misdirected or insufficiently specific FOIA requests may be referred or clarified, but the specific response to Owens was not published with authenticated identifiers and no agency confirmation was located.
